name: application-logic-branch-row
title: Logic Branch Row
description: Survey-builder conditional-flow rule row: "If [question] [operator] [value] then jump to [question]" as chained dropdowns with a delete action and an Add rule control.
useWhen: Building a survey or form builder's skip-logic editor where a response determines which question to jump to next.
You need multiple independent if/then rules stacked in a list, each individually deletable.
Distinct from Conditional Field Group, which reveals or hides fields within the same form based on a checkbox, rather than defining a jump target to a different question entirely.
avoidWhen: Fields should show/hide inline within the same form rather than branch to a different question — use Conditional Field Group instead.
There's only one fixed condition with no builder UI needed — a static conditional is simpler than an editable rule row.
responsiveBehavior: The condition dropdowns wrap onto multiple lines on narrow viewports rather than shrinking below a readable width; the delete button stays pinned to the row's trailing edge via margin-left auto.
accessibility: Each dropdown in the chain carries a distinct aria-label (question/operator/value/target) since their visible content alone doesn't convey their role in the sentence.
The delete button carries an aria-label naming its action, since its content is an icon only.
"Add rule" is a normal text-labeled button, keyboard-operable without relying on the plus icon for meaning.
